plugins.label: Tournament Access
plugins.description: Whitelist / join gate for tournament matches — restricts who can join based on a tournament roster.

plugins.label: Chat RCON
plugins.description: !rcon in chat — tiered ACL console passthrough for referees/admins. Pair with chat_rcon_acl.py. Registered at permission 0 but the handler enforces its own ref/admin tiers internally (qlx_chatRconRefPerm / qlx_chatRconAdminPerm).

plugins.label: ⚠️ chat_rcon helper — DO NOT ENABLE separately
plugins.description: Pure ACL helper module for chat_rcon.py (no minqlx.Plugin class of its own). Must stay present as a file but is not itself a loadable plugin — enabling it standalone will error.

plugins.label: Lobby
plugins.description: Lobby instance plugin — auto-redirects players from a lobby server to the right destination match server.

plugins.label: Match Restore
plugins.description: Checkpoint / restore — saves and restores full match state (player positions, health, armor, items, score, clock) at referee-triggered checkpoints.

plugins.label: ⚠️ match_restore helper — DO NOT ENABLE separately
plugins.description: Support module for match_restore.py (no minqlx.Plugin class of its own). Must stay present as a file but is not itself a loadable plugin.

plugins.label: Match Restore Lab
plugins.description: Optional lab/debug commands for match_restore — item-spawn timers, low-level item entity tools, manual match clock control, single-player state debug. Not used in a real tournament restore; requires match_restore to be loaded.

plugins.label: Native Demo Match Packer
plugins.description: Packages finished match demos into a .qlmatch. Recording and cutting are the engine's own now: set sv_demoRecord 1 (records every client, upstream semantics) and sv_demoCut 1 (the engine detects match start/end itself, cuts each POV to the match window and names the files after the match). This plugin only listens for demo_match_finalized and launches the external qlmatch-packer (deployed to /home/ql/qlmatch-packer/ by host setup / Update Plugins), which parses the POVs, builds the zip, renders the filename template and delivers via rclone. Requires a minqlxtended build from the fork's demo-match-capture branch at or past the demo-cut redesign (qlds_engine_flavor=minqlxtended, source=build).

plugins.label: ⚠️ demo_native_autorecord helper — DO NOT ENABLE separately
plugins.description: Support module for demo_native_autorecord.py (no minqlx.Plugin class of its own; pure manifest/window/zip-building helpers, no minqlx import). Must stay present as a file but is not itself a loadable plugin.

plugins.label: ⚠️ minqlxtended compat shim — DO NOT ENABLE separately
plugins.description: Lets plugins written for minqlx (e.g. ips.py) run unmodified on a minqlxtended-patched host by resolving `import minqlx` to the real minqlxtended module. Not a loadable plugin itself — has no minqlx.Plugin class. Only needed when the target host runs the minqlxtended-patched runtime.

plugins.label: Telemetry (Unified)
plugins.description: Sends live match/player/pickup telemetry to the host's local ql-telemetry-relay sidecar for stats-hub ingestion. Low-priority frame hook — designed not to cost sv_fps. Enable + configure the relay from the host's Telemetry Relay panel, then reserve this instance's server_id there.

plugins.label: ⚠️ telemetry helper — DO NOT ENABLE separately
plugins.description: Pure scheduler/state-machine helper for stream_telemetry_unified.py (no minqlx.Plugin class of its own). Must stay present as a file but is not itself a loadable plugin.

plugins.label: ⚠️ telemetry helper — DO NOT ENABLE separately
plugins.description: Support module for stream_telemetry_unified.py (no minqlx.Plugin class of its own). Must stay present as a file but is not itself a loadable plugin.

addons.label: Live Demo Stream
addons.description: Points an instance's sv_demoStream* cvars at the central demo-stream relay and registers its route with ql-stats-hub, so a spectator can watch a POV live. Unlike the telemetry relay there is nothing to install per host - the relay is one address for the whole cluster.

addons.label: Qlmatch Packer
addons.description: Deploys the external Node.js qlmatch-packer (+ Node 22 runtime) to every managed host after setup / "Update Plugins", and makes demo-management recognise the .qlmatch/.replay.json.gz files it produces (the .packer.log it also writes is deliberately never surfaced there). Cvars (qlx_qlmatchNameTemplate, qlx_qlmatchRcloneTargets) live on the demo_native_autorecord plugin's own manifest, editable from the Plugins tab -- this addon's own settings only control whether the replay sidecar shows up in the Demos widget.

addons.label: Telemetry Relay
addons.description: Forwards live match/player/pickup telemetry from each game instance to ql-stats-hub through a per-host relay sidecar.
